page.body:
Check Availability


Checking Availability and Registering Your Client
Effortlessly contact the listing agent and schedule showings with PropertyList.


Our intuitive platform makes it a breeze to check property availability, request showings, and register your clients—all in just a few clicks.

Access the MLS

  1. Log in to your PropertyList.es account.
  2. On the left-hand side, click the “MLS” (Multiple Listing Service) tab to access all properties.
  3. Select the Property
  4. Browse through the listings and select the property you wish to show to your client.

Check Availability

  1. Click the “Check Availability” button located at the top left of the property details page.
  2. Message: Send a message to the listing agent and optionally request a specific date and time for a showing with your client.
  3. Register Client’s Name (optional): You can also register your client’s name with the agency directly from this appointment request. This ensures that the agency can check if the client is already registered with their company and is aware of who will be attending the showing.
  4. Send the Request


Once all the details are filled in, click the “Send” button to submit your appointment request.

Confirmation

You will receive a copy of the appointment request in your email and withing your aPropertylist account in the "Sent Email" tab for your records.


By following these steps, you can efficiently schedule showings and ensure that all necessary parties are informed.


Disclaimer:
Please note that by registering your client’s name with an agency through PropertyList.es, you agree to our terms & conditions and privacy policy. All members have agreed that this information will be used solely for the purpose of scheduling and managing property showings. We are committed to protecting your client’s privacy and ensuring that their data is handled securely.
